content: First accusation as told in the dissertation from Nafsat al-Maṣdūr I: envious individuals in Isfahan went to Shāhrukh's court in Herat and accused Ibn Turka of deviation from the Sunna through bias toward Sufism (ṣūfīgarī). Despite age and frail health he travelled to Herat, gained Shāhrukh's favour, was offered restoration as qadi of Isfahan, and chose Yazd instead.
